scripts.build: npm run build -w @chapterflow/domain-core && npm run build -w @chapterflow/project-store && npm run build -w @chapterflow/dsh-harness-adapter && npm run build -w @chapterflow/dsh-client-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chapterflow/domain-core && npm run typecheck -w @chapterflow/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @chapterflow/dsh-harness-adapter && npm run typecheck -w @chapterflow/dsh-client-ui
scripts.profile:init: dsh chapterflow --from-default-profile web --dump-config > /dev/null && dsh plugin --profile chapterflow add ./packages/harness-adapter ./packages/client-ui
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run profile:init && dsh chapterflow --patch ./apps/profile/web.cordis.patch.yml
